title: Formal Place Settings
description: Rental stock dressed for a formal seated dinner — gold-scroll chargers, navy napkins, gold flatware, and a royal blue runner. The same stock takes a softer setting just as well: blush napkins, gold flatware, and full glassware laid out on a round table for a seated service.

alt./photos/about/rental-charger-detail.jpg: Gold-scroll charger plate with a navy napkin and gold flatware, place setting detail
alt.royal-blue-runner-gold-chargers.jpg: A long table with a royal blue satin runner, gold charger plates, blue napkins, and eucalyptus down the centre
alt.blush-and-gold-round-table.jpg: A round table laid for a seated dinner with blush napkins, gold flatware, printed menus, and full glassware at every cover
